goals: Verify that readyDtdService removes the project from the WAITERS map when the Dart Tooling Daemon service is immediately ready
Verify that the WAITERS map is cleared after the asynchronous completion of the Dart Tooling Daemon service becoming ready
activities: Initialize mocks and register the mock DartToolingDaemonService
Set the mock DartToolingDaemonService to return true for getWebSocketReady
Create a DtdUtils instance and call readyDtdService with the project
Verify that the resulting CompletableFuture is done
Verify that the WAITERS map is empty
Set the mock DartToolingDaemonService to return false for getWebSocketReady
Create a DtdUtils instance and call readyDtdService with the project
Verify that the project is in the WAITERS map
Update the mock DartToolingDaemonService to return true for getWebSocketReady
Wait up to 5 seconds for the CompletableFuture to complete
Verify that the CompletableFuture is done
Poll for up to 2 seconds until the WAITERS map becomes empty
Verify that the WAITERS map is empty
